evals.name: what_am_i_missing
evals.prompt: What is my portfolio missing? Run a gap analysis.
evals.expect_behavior: Confirms graph exists, runs src.knowledge.gap, returns suggested missing tickers and themes with reasons.

evals.name: heuristic_fallback
evals.prompt: Find blind spots in my coverage, but the local LLM is offline.
evals.expect_behavior: Gap stage falls back to the deterministic heuristic; result reports source=heuristic.

evals.name: graph_not_built
evals.prompt: What sectors am I missing? (graph not yet built)
evals.expect_behavior: Detects missing graph.json and defers to building-portfolio-knowledge-graph.

evals.name: wrong_skill_links
evals.prompt: Show the hidden links between NVDA and my energy names.
evals.expect_behavior: Defers to discovering-portfolio-alpha because this asks about existing links, not missing coverage.
